Attribute Security Overview

This document explains how data flows. It is intended for security teams.

Data Collection

To provide detailed cost allocations, Attribute utilizes three primary data sources:

  • Consumption Data: Collected via the proprietary Attribute Sensor.
  • Finance Data: Pulled from your cloud billing reports.

Sensor details

The sensor is built on eBPF technology. It operates read-only.
